create_emulator_simulator: create an EmulatorSimulator instance with an EmulatorConfig to control an Android emulator
send_touch_events: send touch events to the emulator screen with x, y coordinates and finger identifiers
send_key_events: send keyboard events to the emulator using XKB keycodes and event types
save_load_emulator_state: save and load emulator snapshots using the snapshot service stub by snapshot name
get_emulator_screenshot: get a screenshot from the emulator as a numpy RGBA array via gRPC
